sv.title: Pappan fick nog – sonen ska vräkas
sv.summary: En Uppsalapappa tröttnade på sin son – och drog honom till domstol. Nu ska sonen vräkas, skriver Hem & Hyra.

en.title: Dad had enough – son to be evicted
en.summary: An Uppsala father grew tired of his son – and took him to court. Now the son is to be evicted, Hem & Hyra writes.
